name: drive a structured socket request-response protocol
definition: Send text-encoded requests, read JSON responses, and parse positions under a single-request-per-turn discipline.
failure_mode: Protocol or blocking misuse hangs or crashes the game loop.

name: emit a combined key-and-certificate pem file
definition: concatenate the private key material and the certificate into one PEM file standing in as a combined bundle.
failure_mode: missing or malformed combined pem fails its presence/parse check
